content: समाश्रि €1 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To go to for protection, fly for refuge. .²2 To suffer, experience, or enjoy; लोकेऽथवा तनुभृतां निजकर्मपाकं नित्यं समाश्रितवतां सुहितक्रियाणाम् <ls>Pt. 1. 372</ls>. .²3 To observe, practise, follow. .²4 To rest or depend on. .²5 To confide in. .²6 To attain to, obtain, assume.
